issue.title: sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig TC-SIM-01-01: DebugAllocator leak - discarded AppendResult.record.metadata never freed
issue.task: WF-03 Issue Resolving for GH-753 / ISS-0691: tests/integration/sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig's TC-SIM-01-01 leaks one heap allocation per run. The AppendResult returned by store.append() at line ~264 is captured with `_ =`, so the heap allocation made inside Store.append()'s successful-return path (src/event_store/store.zig:893 Store.append -> src/event_store/store.zig:1357-1381 duplicateFromParams() -> src/event_store/store.zig:1368 allocator.dupe(u8, metadata) catch "") is never freed. Confirmed independent of GH-752/ISS-0211 advisory-lock contention cascade: the leak happens synchronously inside Store.append()'s success path on every run, not only on timeout/abort. Fix is in the test only: capture the AppendResult and free result.record.metadata (matching the pattern already used elsewhere in the same file for real_events / freeEventRecords). No production code change required; this is a test-only MINOR defect. Run the full WF-03 pipeline (Step 00 ISSUE-FIXER registry lookup + GitHub filing + ISS file update -> Step 01 root-cause diagnosis -> Step 02 CODE-DESIGNER fix design -> Step 02b CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR hard gate -> Step 03 BACKEND-DEV implement -> Step 04 TEST-DESIGNER -> Step 04b TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR hard gate -> Step 05 TEST-RUNNER verify (including test-env-verify green and the specific test passing under DebugAllocator) -> Step 07 DOC-UPDATER -> Step Final BACKEND-DEV git-merge). Confirm test isolation baseline is unchanged.
